Q: Exclude a specific series from exporting to csv A:

Highcharts has this series option: includeInDataExport that should do what you need.

See: https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/series.line.includeInDataExport

...
series: [
  {
    name: 'solidgauge',
    type: 'solidgauge',
    data: [data.value],
    ...
  },
  {
    name: 'gauge',
    type: 'gauge',
    data: [data.value],
    includeInDataExport: false,
    ...
  },
]
...

Q: Error: Session invalidated unexpectedly on NFC call Codename iOS A:

Fix the build hints as:

A . here. Not an _:

ios.add_libs=;CoreNFC.framework

For Entitlements I'm not sure but try:

ios.entitlementsInject=<key>com.apple.developer.nfc.readersession.formats</key>

TAGNDEF

For the usage description use:

ios.NSNFCReaderUsageDescription=NFC tag to read NDEF messages into the application

I think you need to remove the ios.plistInject since all of the stuff seems to be stuff that we already inject ourselves.

Q: podman fails to mount external volumes on MacOS A:

I inited the machine with the external drive as a volume pointing to /host data and another volume to $HOME:$HOME so both (absolute mapping and relative mapping) would work with the external volume:

podman machine init -v /Volumes/Extended/podman/:/hostdata -v $HOME:$HOME --disk-size 12 -m 8192 --rootful --now

Then I can mound relative paths with compose:

volumes:

  • ./nginx/configs/:/data/configs

and I can also use the external drive when needed:

volumes:

  • /hostdata/db-path/:/var/data/mysql

IMPORTANT: please notice that the hostdata is the target path on the podman machine.

Q: Laravel loading twice all pages A:

In my case, the issue was resolved by reinstalling the Composer dev dependencies.

What worked for me was running the following commands in sequence:

composer install --no-dev
composer install

After doing this, the application stopped loading each page twice.

I’m not entirely sure what caused the behavior, but it seems likely that one of the installed dependencies or the autoload files was in an inconsistent or corrupted state, and reinstalling the dependencies regenerated them correctly.

Hopefully this helps anyone else who encounters the same issue.
